# Newport Centurions Korfball Club

> Mixed-gender korfball club in Newport, Wales. Welsh League Champions 2022, 2023 & 2025. Beginners welcome, first 2 sessions free.

## Key Information
- Sport: Korfball (Dutch mixed-gender team sport, 4 male + 4 female per team)
- Location: The John Frost School, Duffryn, Newport NP10 8YD, Wales
- Training: Tuesdays 6:00-8:00 PM, Thursdays 8:00-9:00 PM
- Season starts: August 18th, 2026
- Beginner sessions: 8 Sep, 15 Sep, 22 Sep 2026
- Founded: 2019
- Members: 30+ across 3 competitive teams

## About Korfball
- Mixed-gender sport: 4 male, 4 female per team
- No dribbling - emphasis on teamwork and passing
- Open to all ages and fitness levels
- Competing in Welsh League and Western Regional League
- Monthly social events including Payday Pub Day at The Tiny Rebel
